name: 84 - Core - Dispatch Queued Messages - Standalone Final

parameters.query:
WITH due AS (
  SELECT m.id
  FROM outbound_messages m
  WHERE m.status IN ('queued','scheduled','failed')
    AND m.next_attempt_at<=NOW()
    AND m.scheduled_at<=NOW()
    AND m.attempt_count<m.max_attempts
  ORDER BY m.priority DESC,m.next_attempt_at,m.created_at
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT $1::INTEGER
),
claimed AS (
  UPDATE outbound_messages m
  SET status='processing',
      attempt_count=m.attempt_count+1,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM due
  WHERE m.id=due.id
  RETURNING m.*
),
rows AS (
  SELECT
    c.id outbound_message_id,c.clinic_id,clinic.name clinic_name,
    c.patient_id,c.channel,c.purpose,
    c.message_type,c.template_code,c.language,c.recipient,c.subject,
    c.message_text,c.payload,c.related_entity_type,c.related_entity_id,
    c.request_reference,c.idempotency_key,c.priority,c.attempt_count,
    c.max_attempts,c.scheduled_at,
    a.id adapter_id,a.adapter_name,a.adapter_url,
    a.request_timeout_seconds,a.enabled adapter_enabled
  FROM claimed c
  INNER JOIN clinics clinic
    ON clinic.id=c.clinic_id
  LEFT JOIN communication_channel_adapters a
    ON a.clinic_id=c.clinic_id
   AND a.channel=c.channel
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(rows)) FROM rows),'[]'::JSONB) messages,
  COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rows),0) claimed_count;

conditions.leftValue: ={{ Boolean($('Prepare Dispatch Permission Request').item.json.adapter_enabled) && Boolean($('Prepare Dispatch Permission Request').item.json.adapter_url) }}

parameters.query:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT $1::BIGINT message_id,NULLIF($2::BIGINT,0) adapter_id,
         $3::INTEGER attempt_number,$4::TEXT result,
         NULLIF($5::TEXT,'') provider_message_id,
         NULLIF($6::TEXT,'') error_code,NULLIF($7::TEXT,'') error_message,
         $8::JSONB request_payload,$9::JSONB response_payload,
         $10::INTEGER max_attempts
),
attempt AS (
  INSERT INTO outbound_message_attempts(
    outbound_message_id,attempt_number,adapter_id,request_payload,response_payload,
    result,provider_message_id,error_code,error_message,completed_at
  )
  SELECT message_id,attempt_number,adapter_id,request_payload,response_payload,
         result,provider_message_id,error_code,error_message,NOW()
  FROM r
  ON CONFLICT(outbound_message_id,attempt_number) DO UPDATE SET
    adapter_id=EXCLUDED.adapter_id,response_payload=EXCLUDED.response_payload,
    result=EXCLUDED.result,provider_message_id=EXCLUDED.provider_message_id,
    error_code=EXCLUDED.error_code,error_message=EXCLUDED.error_message,
    completed_at=NOW()
  RETURNING *
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE outbound_messages m
  SET attempt_count=CASE
        WHEN r.result='deferred' THEN GREATEST(m.attempt_count-1,0)
        ELSE m.attempt_count
      END,
      status=CASE
        WHEN r.result='accepted' THEN 'accepted'
        WHEN r.result='blocked' THEN 'blocked'
        WHEN r.result='deferred' THEN 'scheduled'
        WHEN m.attempt_count>=m.max_attempts THEN 'failed'
        ELSE 'failed'
      END,
      provider_message_id=COALESCE(r.provider_message_id,m.provider_message_id),
      last_error_code=r.error_code,
      last_error_message=r.error_message,
      accepted_at=CASE WHEN r.result='accepted' THEN NOW() ELSE m.accepted_at END,
      failed_at=CASE WHEN r.result IN ('failed','adapter_missing','timeout') THEN NOW() ELSE m.failed_at END,
      next_attempt_at=CASE
        WHEN r.result='deferred' THEN NOW()+INTERVAL '1 hour'
        WHEN r.result IN ('failed','adapter_missing','timeout')
          THEN NOW()+MAKE_INTERVAL(mins=>LEAST(240,GREATEST(5,POWER(2,m.attempt_count)::INTEGER*5)))
        ELSE m.next_attempt_at
      END,
      updated_at=NOW()
  FROM r
  WHERE m.id=r.message_id
  RETURNING m.*
)
SELECT TRUE success,'dispatch_outcome_saved' result,
       (SELECT id FROM updated) outbound_message_id,
       (SELECT status FROM updated) message_status,
       (SELECT attempt_count FROM updated) attempt_count,
       (SELECT next_attempt_at FROM updated) next_attempt_at,
       (SELECT provider_message_id FROM updated) provider_message_id;
